verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party capability to stream events from Mixpanel to third-party destinations such as CRMs, ad platforms, or registrable outbound webhooks. The Raw Event Export API is a pull-based download, which is only a building block a developer could use to construct forwarding. Warehouse Connectors and partners like Census and Vendo bring data into Mixpanel rather than routing it onward.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream events onward to third-party destinations (CRM, ad platforms, webhooks) from the analytics platform
